_comment: The root of the checkout, for the layers smart-hiv mounts (index.lock.json). Added 2026-11-13, ported from smart-base#362: site-publish.yml failed with "Cannot find module '@litlfred/cat-harness-tools/schemas/kg/cat-harness.ts' from fhir-harness/scripts/stage-local-ig.ts": the mounted layers import each other by package name, and nothing resolves those names without a root workspace.
name: @litlfred/smart-hiv-site
_workspaces_comment: The mounted code layers that carry a package.json, as workspaces; bootstrap declares no dependencies, so it is not listed. smart-base is mounted but is not a workspace: its scripts reach zod and @litlfred/bootstrap-tools through the ONE root node_modules that bunfig.toml's hoisted linker lays out.
_overrides_comment: As smart-trust's: expo is reached only through fhir-harness's fhirclient -> isomorphic-webcrypto -> optional expo-random, and expo's latest asks for an @expo/cli npm does not have, so an install with no lockfile fails to resolve without the pin; the others keep the versions the sibling sites resolve.
